copy.description: Have more questions? We're happy to chat. Reach out anytime.

items.question: What's the difference between a career coach and a recruiter?
items.answer: A recruiter works for employers to fill specific positions. A career coach works for you—helping you identify your goals, develop your professional brand, improve your job search skills, and navigate your entire career trajectory. We're your partner, not a middleman.

items.question: How much does career coaching cost?
items.answer: We offer several coaching packages to fit different needs and budgets. Our initial discovery call is free, where we'll discuss your goals and recommend the best approach. Individual sessions start at $175, and our comprehensive programs offer better value for ongoing support.

items.question: I'm not sure what career I want. Can you still help?
items.answer: Absolutely! Many clients come to us feeling uncertain about their direction. Our career clarity process helps you explore your strengths, values, and interests to identify paths that genuinely fit who you are—not just what looks good on paper.

items.question: How long does it typically take to land a new job?
items.answer: Every situation is different, but most clients in active job search mode see significant progress within 2-3 months. Factors include your industry, target role, and how much time you can dedicate. We focus on quality opportunities, not just any job.

items.question: Do you help with executive-level positions?
items.answer: Yes! We work with professionals at all levels, from early career to C-suite. Our executive coaching includes board positioning, executive presence, salary negotiation for high-stakes offers, and navigating complex organizational dynamics.
